caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden table placed in the corner of a room, as indicated by the intersecting lines representing the walls and floor in the background. The table is shown in three-quarter perspective, with the longer side parallel to the back wall. It has four straight, slender legs and an overall reddish-brown wooden texture with visible grain patterns. There is a single drawer on the left side, featuring a round metal pull handle. The right side of the table has a leaf that is down, suggesting it may be a drop-leaf table. The edges and corners of the table are outlined with darker lines for emphasis. The drawing is bordered by a double-line frame, and the background is blank except for the linear indications of the room's walls and floor. The colors used are primarily shades of brown and red for the table, with lines in purple or blue to outline both the furniture and the boundaries of the room and page.
title: Drop-leaf Table
